source.title: Honest Coffee Guide: 1Zpresso K-Plus grind settings
source.notes: 1Zpresso's chart does not list cold brew. Honest Coffee Guide K-Max 110–174.

procedure.en: Turn the external ring clockwise until you feel resistance, not the tightest position. That is zero; it may be offset by two or more clicks from the printed 0. Count rotations, numbers and clicks counter-clockwise from there. Do not turn the handle within the first few clicks from zero.
procedure.pt-BR: Gire o anel externo no sentido horário até sentir resistência, não a posição mais apertada. Esse é o zero; ele pode ficar dois ou mais cliques fora do 0 impresso. Conte as voltas, os números e os cliques no sentido anti-horário a partir dali. Não gire a manivela nos primeiros cliques a partir do zero.

notes: External ring: 9 numbers per rotation, 90 clicks per rotation, 10 clicks per number; range goes above one rotation (Honest Coffee Guide charts to 160). 22 µm per click (0.022 mm) is 1Zpresso's published burr travel, not particle size. K-Max and K-Pro share the mechanism and the official chart; Honest Coffee Guide's K-Max numbers differ by 1–5 clicks (see band notes). All values stored as clicks from zero; the official chart's Point axis is dial numbers (10 clicks each).
